name: Loop Slicer Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Loop Slicer styles: 69 slice setups for the built-in demo loop (a one-bar drum break at 120 BPM): rearranged slice patterns, chops, stutters, reversed and pitched hits, and sparse hits to play from keys. Every folder works directly without loading anything. The 8 tunes in the folder Own Loop keep the loop you have loaded and only change how it is sliced and played: they stay silent until a loop is loaded. Sequencer tunes need the transport running; tunes without a pattern are played with notes from MIDI note 36 upward (one slice per key).
